plots.brief: Three-storey stone watermill, about 11x9 walls on a chiselled plinth, standing half over the river so its undershot wheel (spruce, 6 blocks across) turns on the west face in the current. Pale stone with spruce timber and a deepslate-tile roof, a small copper-roofed hoist gable over the loading door on the quay side (east). Sacks and a hoist beam on the quay; one blue banner.

Long boathouse about 14x8 walls, the west half on spruce piles over the river with an open slip and a raised arched water gate; stone ground floor to the quay, a store loft above under a low deepslate roof. Plain, little trim; rowing boats and a hanging lantern at the slip.

A net-loft boathouse about 14x8, half over the river, with one tall spruce-boarded loft and a hoist beam above the slip. Stone quay-side office with a shuttered window; nets drying on racks beside the door.

plots.type: water stairs and covered footbridge landing
plots.brief: The district's one special detail: a broad flight of stone water stairs (7 wide) stepping down into the river, flanked by a small covered landing about 8x6 with a spruce-beamed roof on stone piers and a deep blue banner, from which a covered spruce footbridge on piers starts out toward the west bank (the bridge itself is built later). Mooring rings and a bench under the roof.

Long stone barge warehouse about 13x11 walls, two storeys, plain pale stone on a stone-brick plinth with spruce timber doors and a loading hoist over the quay (west). Deepslate roof, few windows, tall cargo doors; barrels and crates stacked beside the quay.

Second warehouse about 13x11, two storeys, with a stepped stone gable end and three wide spruce loading doors onto the quay (west), an upper hoist door. Plain stone, deepslate roof; a clerk's lean-to office at the north corner.

Brewery about 13x11 walls, two storeys, with a tall stone chimney and a louvred malting-loft gable; stone ground floor with arched cart doors facing the quay (west), spruce timber loft above. Hop poles and barrels in the yard; the detail is a copper brewing-kettle roof lantern over the brewhouse.

The quay's finest plain building: about 12x9, two tall storeys of smooth stone and diorite with stone-mullioned windows, a small oxidised-copper gutter line and a spruce door under a shallow arcade of three arches facing the quay (west). Deepslate roof; scales and a deep blue banner beside the door.

Plain terraced house about 9x9 walls, two storeys on a low stone plinth, calcite walls with spruce shutters and door, deepslate roof running parallel to the avenue (door east). Window boxes, a stone chimney on the party wall; first of the terrace.

Terraced house about 9x9, three storeys and narrow, pale stone with spruce window frames, deepslate roof, door east with two steps. Slightly taller than its neighbours; a copper downpipe and a hanging sign.
Terraced house about 9x9, two storeys with an attic dormer, diorite and stone-brick walls, spruce door and shutters, deepslate roof. Chimney at the south party wall; a small herb bed beside the door.

Terraced house about 9x9, two storeys, plain pale stone with spruce timber and a deepslate roof; a ground-floor shopfront window (a chandler or rope-maker) with a spruce shutter that folds into a counter, door east.
End-of-terrace house about 10x9, two storeys, with a side garden wall and a gated archway through to the quay lane; pale stone, spruce door, deepslate roof, one blue banner on the corner.

Shallow, long tannery about 18x8 walls, one storey plus loft, plain stone with spruce drying racks and a louvred loft; the yard's soaking pits (stone-lined cauldron vats) face the river on the west side, hides hung on spruce frames. Low deepslate roof, door east to the avenue.

Open-sided market hall about 18x10 on stone piers: a long deepslate roof on stone posts over spruce stalls with stone slab counters, a gutter line in oxidised copper; the west end opens onto a stepped landing at the river. Banner at each end; the southern end of the quays, beside the west-avenue.

The district's quiet centre: a grassed quay green about 15x13 on the low west bank where the lanes meet, ringed by a low stone kerb. A spruce-roofed well in the middle, two benches, net-drying posts, three pollarded trees in stone planters and a mooring stone by the water; a plain stone path from the lane to the river. One blue banner on a post.

Plain two-storey house about 9x8 walls on a 15x11 plot, pale stone with spruce timber and a deepslate roof, door south onto the quay lane. A ropewalk lean-to on the west side, coils and floats in the window, a hanging rope sign. Little trim.

Small one-and-a-half-storey stone ferryman's house about 7x7 walls on an 11x10 plot, door west onto the lane. Spruce shutters, deepslate roof, a bell on a post and a lantern by the door; a stone path runs on to a spruce ferry pier on piles out over the water, with a moored ferry boat.

Low cooperage about 8x7 walls, stone ground floor with a spruce-timber loft, deepslate roof, door west onto the lane. Barrels and hoop racks in a fenced side yard; a hoist beam over the loft door. The waterward side stands on piles with a small dock for barrel boats.

plots.type: net shed boathouse over the water
plots.brief: Shallow boat and net shed about 8x5 walls, partly on spruce piles over the river bend at the south end of the lane; stone landward end, spruce-boarded seaward end, low deepslate roof, an open slip with rowing boats and nets on racks. Door west onto the lane.
